notes: *grew up with* keeps the supplied preposition that the English verb needs to reach its object suffix (rule 44); the suffix takes only *me* (rule 18).

*as with* is read as one rendering of the single כְ, headed on the word carrying the comparative relation (rules 30, 24); the competing readings are to mark the second *with* `added` or to give it to the verb as a distributed repetition under rule 25.
